answer_1.quote: We address these two limitations by reformulating EE annotation as text generation ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural-language text for event arguments (explicit, implicit, scattered)

answer_2.quote: We employ a relaxed match approach based on semantic similarity ... We compute BERT-based semantic similarity ... calculate the F1 score based on both relaxed and exact matches and denote them as RM_F1 and EM_F1.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a qualitative human evaluation on a subset of the best-performing GPT-4 outputs. The evaluation revealed that although the outputs are semantically similar, the exact-match evaluation frequently marked them as incorrect.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters assessed whether the generated arguments were semantically similar to the ground‑truth arguments.
